The word पति is called घि only when it is in a compound.

Terms: घि संज्ञा

The words like पात्रे-सम्मित 'a dish-companion' (a parasite) etc. are तत्-पुरुष compounds when contempt is implied.

Terms: समास-तत्-पुरुष

The substitute न् replaces the final इ of पति before the feminine affix ङीप् when the word so formed means 'a wife' who takes part in the sacrifices of her husband.

Terms: विभक्ति-ङीप्

When preceded by a word denoting 'a draught animal', रथ takes the affix अञ् in the sense of 'this is his'.

Terms: अञ्

After a word denoting a draught-animal and after the words 1. अध्वर्यु and 2. परिषद् the affix अञ् is added.

Terms: अञ्

The affix ष्ठान् (-/- इक) comes in the sense of 'sown with so much' after the word पात्र।

Terms:

The affix घञ् (-/- इयं) together with यत् (यं) comes in the sense of 'deserving that' after the word पात्र।

Terms: घञ्

The affix यक् comes in the sense of 'nature or action thereof' after a compound ending with पति and after पुरोहित etc.

Terms: यक्

The first member of a तत्-पुरुष समास preserves its original accent when it ends in पति and means 'master' or 'lord'.

Terms: तत्-पुरुष समास

The augment प् is added after the vowel of a root पत् 'to fall' in the Aorist अङ्।

Terms: Shortening

स् may diversely be substituted for the विसर्ग of the Ablative -5th case before the verb पातु in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

Terms: विसर्ग सन्धि
